name: cn-compliance-guard
title_zh: 上架前扫一遍，广告法违禁词当场标红
tagline_zh: 200+违禁词、6类法律风险、5大平台SEO规则一次查完。不只告诉你哪里违规，还给出能安全替换的说法。
tagline_en: Scans 200+ banned words, 6 legal risk types, 5 platform SEO rules. Flags violations and suggests safe.
desc_en: Scan Chinese text for 200+ banned words across 6 legal categories (广告法/消费者权益保护法), check SEO compliance for 5 platforms (百度/小红书/抖音/淘宝/京东), and provide safe replacement suggestions. Detects 绝对化用语, 医疗效果承诺, 虚假宣传, 金融承诺, 诱导消费, 比较广告. Use when: checking Chinese marketing copy for legal compliance, reviewing product descriptions for advertising law violations, auditing content before publishing on Chinese
why_zh: 把广告法、消保法的抽象条款编译成可执行的检查清单，连平台SEO偏好也纳入同一套规则。
why_en: Turns vague ad-law clauses into an executable checklist, merging platform SEO quirks into one pass—no more guessing what.
limit_zh: 只认简体中文营销文案，不覆盖合同、公告等非广告文体；替换建议基于通用合规，不保证特定平台审核必过。
limit_en: Simplified-Chinese marketing copy only; not for contracts or notices. Rewrites are generic, not platform-guaranteed. Needs internet for latest rules.
title_en: Pre-publish scan for China ad-law banned words
